nodes.label: Ponytail Lazy Senior Dev Mode
nodes.rationale: The best code is the code never written: climb the ladder (YAGNI, reuse existing code, stdlib, native platform, installed deps, one line, then minimum code) only after fully understanding the problem; shortest working diff wins.

nodes.label: Root-Cause Bug Fixing
nodes.rationale: A bug report names a symptom: grep every caller of the touched function and fix the shared function once — one guard there is a smaller diff than a guard per caller, and patching only the reported path leaves sibling callers broken.

nodes.label: Use Graphify Before Grep
nodes.rationale: This repository is indexed by the Graphify code graph; query definitions, callers, blast radius, and test coverage through Graphify MCP before reaching for grep or file reads, falling back only for literal strings or non-indexed files.
